question: Should ClawScan adopt the canonical autoreview inspection, model-fallback, and supported-engine contract exactly as pinned?
rationale: Exact parity and strong validation establish implementation quality, but removal of existing engine paths and the new security-sensitive reviewer access model require repository-owner authorization.

options.title: Adopt canonical contract
options.body: Accept the complete pinned upstream tree and its compatibility and trust policy as ClawScan’s review standard.

options.title: Revise upstream first
options.body: Change any unsuitable behavior in `openclaw/agent-skills`, then resynchronize the complete tree without local divergence.

recommendation.title: Adopt canonical contract
recommendation.body: Accept the complete pinned upstream tree and its compatibility and trust policy as ClawScan’s review standard.
